title: Exact banker's rounding of decimal strings
skill: Numerics: exact decimal arithmetic vs binary floating point
traps: binary floats cannot represent 2.675 exactly, so float-based code rounds it the wrong way
only an exact tie goes to even; 2.6750001 is above half
carry can ripple through all digits (9.995 -> 10.00)
negative zero must print as unsigned zero
inputs can have more digits than a float holds
